headline: Harry Kane Scores Winner In Record Setting England Nations Match
seoTitle: Harry Kane Scores In Record 126th England Appearance
metaDescription: Harry Kane set a new England football appearance record during a 2-1 victory over Croatia, securing the team a place in the UEFA Nations League finals.
aiSummaryBullets: Harry Kane reached 126 appearances for the England men's national team, becoming the country's most-capped player.
The forward scored his 92nd international goal during the 2-1 win against Croatia.
The victory confirmed England's qualification for the UEFA Nations League quarter-finals.
aiContextParagraph: In a recent UEFA Nations League match, England secured a 2-1 victory against Croatia, ensuring their progression to the quarter-final stage of the competition. The game was marked by a historic milestone for forward Harry Kane, who set a new record for the most appearances made by a male player for the England national team, reaching a total of 126 caps. In addition to securing this record, Kane contributed to the match result by scoring his 92nd international goal. Kane has described reaching the milestone as a reflection of his dedication to his professional career and national duties. The match results have received international attention as England continues its campaign in the UEFA tournament. As a Bayern Munich forward, Kane remains a central figure for the England squad during these ongoing international fixtures, which determine standings for the upcoming tournament phases.
whyItIsViral: The story is trending due to coverage across four independent outlets and a high viral activity score following the breaking of a major sporting record.
